'''Volume 46''' is the 46th volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga and the fourth volume in the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

In [[VIZ Media]]'s translation, this volume is published as volume four of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
''A thrilling meeting with one of the Elite Four strains Black’s brain. Then, it’s opening night for White’s Pokémon musical! Will everything go off without a hitch...? Not likely! And what will happen when another Trainer lures away White’s star performer, Tepig Gigi?''

''Plus, will White ever overcome her fears and learn to battle with her Pokémon?!''

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Black}} saves {{p|Victini}} from [[Team Plasma]] on [[Liberty Garden]].
* Black meets [[Grimsley]].
* It is revealed that [[Seven Sages|Sage]] [[Ryoku]] is looking for {{p|Volcarona}} at the [[Relic Castle]].
* The [[Pokémon Musical]] is organized.
* Black defeats [[Elesa]] and encounters {{p|Thundurus}}.
* [[N]] reveals to {{adv|White}} that he is Team Plasma's king.
* White jumps out of the Ferris Wheel car, [[Gigi]] joins N. He leaves his {{p|Servine}} with White.
* Black and White meet [[Alder]].
* White decides to help test the [[Battle Subway]].
* White decides to temporarily close the [[BW Agency]].
